name: ai-disclaimer
description: A short, quiet note that AI-generated content may be wrong — "AI-generated content may be incorrect"

meta.name: AiDisclaimer
meta.description: A short, quiet note that AI-generated content may be wrong — "AI-generated content may be incorrect"

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the default text — e.g. naming the model or what to double-check.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n).

examples.title: Specific
examples.code: <AiDisclaimer>Summaries are generated by AI. Check figures against the source report.</AiDisclaimer>

whenToUse: Under an AI chat composer or answer, telling readers the output can be wrong
Beside AI-generated summaries, drafts or suggestions that people may act on
whenNotToUse: Marking a single field or card as AI-generated — use AiBadge
Warnings the reader must act on — use Alert

antiPatterns.bad: Repeating the disclaimer under every message in a conversation
antiPatterns.good: Show it once, under the composer or at the end of the thread
antiPatterns.why: Repeated boilerplate is skimmed past and stops being read

related.name: AiBadge
related.reason: AiBadge marks which content is AI-generated; the disclaimer says what that means

related.name: Alert
related.reason: Alert is for messages that need attention or action

intent.a11yRationale: A plain paragraph: read in document order, never a live region, because it is static guidance rather than a status change. The sparkle is aria-hidden; muted text keeps AA contrast on every theme

content.tone: Plain and specific — say what may be wrong and what to check

flexibility.note: Typically under a composer or at the foot of AI content
